Cost: 1,000eb (Very Expensive)

Tetratronic takes pride in the fact that its decks are indispensable in combat operations around the globe. Even if it's not entirely true, one thing's for sure – these cyberdecks are powerful.

Neuroport Cyberdeck Port Operating System. The Neuroport Cyberdeck Port can now only accept a Tetratronic Rippler Cyberdeck, one of which is provided with purchase of this Operating System.

The Tetratronic Rippler is a Cyberdeck with 4 Slots that can install Hardware, and 8 Slots that can install Programs. When using this Cyberdeck to perform an Overheat or Synapse Burnout Quickhack, the user may attempt to perform a single DV8 or lower Quickhack against the same target without a Net Action, which is rolled independently.

If either the Overheat/Synapse Burnout or chosen DV8 Quickhack Checks fail, both Quickhacks fail.

Slots: 12

Foundry notes:

  • The sheet has one slot count, so this carries all 12; it won't keep Hardware and Programs to their own 4 and 8.
  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
